name: tex-notes-mkl
description: Short, simplified two-column LaTeX/PDF lecture notes (11 pt, A4, Times) that explain what a source's equations mean and why they matter: every source equation with its number (chapter prefix dropped), 'Reading the equation' bullets, limiting cases, practical use, numerically verified algebra, 1-3 matplotlib figures computed from the equations, a summary table, a green key-message box and a navy 'in plain words' box, page-limit fitting and a required QA pass. Delivers the PDF plus its .tex source. Skills: `tex-notes-mkl`.
